record.selection_reason: Frame 2 is the only gameplay frame that shows an active in-game ability UI (red circular ability icon / vignette) and a nearby player/NPC with a red name/marker near the shelves. The vignette/darkening and ability icon are consistent with Evil Presence being active at short range and there is a nearby character whose movement appears interrupted (red marker/indicator). Menu frames (0,1) do not show in-game evidence, so frame 2 best matches the capture purpose.

sel.selection_reason: Both frames are the in-menu ability/character screen showing 'Evil Presence' and Michael's model — not actual gameplay. There is no chase action, no survivor present, no stagger animation, and no visual evidence of Michael closing distance or cutting off escape. Although a road/car is visible in the background, this is a menu scene and does not prove the capture purpose.
